notes.title: Update annoucement 10/03/2017
notes.content:
Greeting from Creature of the Rise, we have got many feedbacks from  customers , YouTubers and reviewers about our game . We are very appreciated to all of the suggestions and we'll use it for improving our performance better.

[h1] Updates 10/03/2017 [/h1]
[list]
    [*]Decreasing HEPH Price Tag!!!!
    [*]24 in game achievement added.
    [*]Edit background music when player fight an elite encounter.
    [*]Adjust an over shoulder view in game play.
[/list]

Feel free to contact us if you have any suggestion or require, it is our pleasure.

tags.feature: [*]Edit background music when player fight an elite encounter.
